I see the city info. The Builder the '!' refers to is somewhere. But importantly: this is a peaceful city view. The recurring 'UNIT NEEDS ORDERS' is the Builder stuck on the city tile. Since I can't order it, but the city is producing and the game is at turn 129, the real problem is just that I can't end turn. 

Let me reconsider: maybe the Builder ISN'T on the city center but on a tile nearby and all its improvement options show greyed because the tile has no valid improvement (e.g., it's on a resource-less/desert/mountain-adjacent tile). Moving it is what's needed. The Move To deselected instead of arming. 

Given repeated failure, let me just try pressing Escape to dismiss any modal and then click the end-turn '!' one final decisive time, then observe if a turn advances. First close this city panel by clicking the map.
decision.hypothesis: Close city panel, then try Escape to clear stuck pending state.
